review:
イントロで淡々と描かれる人類滅亡。無人の世界で孤独を謳歌する天才美少女に、たった一人の無人機が立ち向かう愛と悲しみの弾幕シューティング。ボタンは手連が必要でちょっと疲れますが、連打ショットのスピードアップでの避けと、ボタン押しっぱなしのパワーショットのメリハリが楽しいゲームです。攻撃が激しいぶん、シールド＆ボム＆残機制なので思ったより被弾してもOK。「あれ、意外と自分やれるぞ？」といった手ごたえが楽しめます。

特筆したいのが作中で退治する無人機たちや、ゲームを繰り返す事で開放されていくバックストーリー。お菓子の名を与えられた謎の兵器たちのルーツや、プレイヤー機と黒幕の思わぬ人間関係。レトロタッチで描かれるヒロインの無垢な可愛さに段々と惹かれ、最終決戦で対峙した際のBGM「Steel Rondo」が胸を打つ。10代とかでやってたらもっと染まってただろうなあって作品。

So while this is a recommend from me, I'm also going to throw in a disclaimer; in my personal experience this game is a bit iffy whenever I wanted to play version 2.0 (no issues with 1.53) ; basically being a coin flip between getting to the main menu or just crashing right before then. But once I make it to the game proper, everything's fine. I was able to play it through to the end without any technical issues. Trying to quit to desktop always seems to result in a crash though.  

Despite that, Mecha Ritz: Steel Rondo is great shmup. The variety in shot types, the stylized and colorful graphics and the satisfying sound effects paired with the FM soundtrack, all wonderful. I really like the rank system, it starts at 0 at the easiest and well over 200 at the hardest. Things can quickly get out of hand the longer you go without taking hit so that becomes its own thrill. Hard to go wrong with branching paths in a genre like this, nice way to mix things up. Survival isn't too bad, actually. You only lose a life once you take a hit without any shields which are generous enough and of course there are bombs too. So you can make it pretty far even if this game has no continues to rely on.

I do wish HEY would do a little more bug-fixing for this game; apparently other people have had different issues beyond what I've experienced. But both that and discount for this game are probably unlikely at this point. P.S. There are some other options at the bottom of the key config menu, including the fullscreen toggle.

这应该是我难得会打出将近满分的独立STG作品了……
先来说说好的地方吧：
1、版面设计异常优秀，有着节奏合适、且极具个人特色之余，又异常土且合理的弹设。虽然高rank弹速特别快，但是实际上大部分版面都可以解，因为这游戏的敌人布局很科学，外加场景变化配合有明显差异的不同种类敌人出场让STG玩家进行背板时会很舒适。
是非常原主义的主规划和解版、弱避弹的土STG。
2、sweet系统简单易懂又不失深度，sweet的存在即是打分项（全连可以每拆一次给25600分），也是混关必须的额外消弹辅助，甚至乎不少道中和boss战都是依赖有规划的拆sweet才能安全打过去，玩起来真是比绊地狱抽5还要快乐无数倍呀.！！！
3、丰富多样，极具个人特色和差异化极大的自机。这些自机的设计相当优异（除了一部分真的就是纯傻逼），哪怕游戏操作只有2键，但是依旧被HEY玩出了花。什么低速“遥控蛇”、蓄力机、校准轮盘、控制子机，你想得到的、想不到的自机都在这个游戏里头！！
4、极其爽快合理的游玩体验，这个就不多说了，玩过都已经栗中毒了！！

当然了，这游戏也有十分不好的地方需要改进！希望作者能看到！（虽然2.01版本发布都是22年的事了）
1、打分极其弱智，由于最后一面的结算分非常多，最终rank等级和残机数所给到的分异常恐怖（每条250W，我试过14号机打最简单路线直接400rank起飞到结算给了我2500W……总分来到了3500W）
导致了你前边研究拆sweet拼全连的心血全部都显得像是小丑一样搞笑，这种结算也太过于荒谬且不合理了！！

2、机体平衡性堪忧：我就不说10号机以及6、13号机到底多弱了，其他机子也基本被8号、3号、给完爆的体无完肤，而打分的话又没任何机子能比无脑稳定消弹又跑得快的14号机媲美……实在是………哎……1号机也是被同胞3号机给完全挤兑死了。
总之就这样吧，我现在正在找反编译STGB文件的方法，到时候我自己想修改一下这些问题。

難易度明示自動調整型縦シューティングゲーム。
ボムを抱えたまま死なない事さえ意識していれば私のように反射神経が腐っているプレイヤーでもクリアできる初心者に優しいゲームだった。

攻撃は連打と押しっぱなしで切り替わる2種類のショットとボムだけでパワーアップなどは無い。
またアイテムも一回被弾を防いでくれるシールドとボム、その両方を一つずつくれるダブルと1UPの4つだけとシンプルな基本システムになっているが、選んだ機体毎に特殊な能力をもっていてそれで変化を付けている。

このゲームの特徴は難易度であるランクが画面右下に常に表示されていて動的に変化することである。
基本的に長く敵にやられずにプレイしていると上がっていきやられると下がるようになっている。
そのため下手なプレイヤーだと低いまま、上手いプレイヤーだと際限なく上がっていく。
この難易度の調整がかなり巧みで低ランクでも簡単すぎず難しすぎずの絶妙な弾幕を張ってくれる。
まぁ私の腕だとランク表示枠は3桁あるにも関わらず30を超えられないので中から高ランクでどういうゲームになるのかさっぱりわからないのだが。

そういう事で少なくともシューティングゲーム初心者には入門用としてお勧めできる。
コンティニューはなく弾幕も一見激しいが当たり判定は小さいしシールドと1UPを頻繁に出してくれるので割と何とかなるぞ。

Some brief points:
[b]EDIT 4 NOV 2022[/b]: Much of the following paragraph may be inaccurate as the major 2.0 update tweaks the overall difficulty, it's easier in many places and the new Sweet Spots mechanic makes periods of no resource use more credible.
- If you attempt to NoMiss/NoBomb any large portion of the game, you will probably bring yourself unnecessary frustration and you may be "missing the point". I would describe the gameplay as an exercise in resource mitigation. At low "Rank" the game is slow and sparse, and due to the ship's shot power flexing with the dynamic rank system, trying to kill bosses within the time limit becomes unrealistic at many points. However, north of Rank 150, the game goes off the rails in a big way, and toward when it caps off at Rank 500, using resources wisely becomes about as important a game mechanic as dodging the bullets.

- The game looks and sounds how biting into a whole orange tastes. Highly complex wavesynth, and a visual design that canonically reflects the teenaged antagonist's tastes in modern art. Pure bliss, if you can finish a session without damaging your hearing. I highly recommend picking up audio post-processing software and turning down the high pitches on your end.

- Whether autofire constitutes cheating is completely subjective so long as you never submit your scores online. This game does not have online leaderboards. Use autofire when playing Type 5.

ランク制で大幅に難易度が変動し、上下する条件もハッキリしているためランクを抑えれば初心者でもかなり遊びやすいのがいい。

元々はフリーゲームだった今作はフリー版であるMecha Ritz(無印)からSteel Rondoとなって
・ルート分岐と３つの新ステージ（[spoiler]及び裏真ボス[/spoiler]）追加
・自機が３×２機追加され、計１２機体に。更に機体選択が分かりやすく。
・多数のBGMがアレンジされた
・UIの改修、スコアシステム刷新、多言語対応、etcetc...
と結構な追加要素と改良が施されている。ただ、今作の魅力はフリー版からでも十分味わえるため購入を迷っている方はフリー版のプレイをぜひともお勧めする。

Heard this recommended on shmups.system11 as a shmup to not overlook and it was half off on a sale so I took the plunge.
Verdict: Super solid shmup.

While numbers are not everything, I do think they're a big deal in shmups, so here's some quick and dirty stats to entice you, curious buyer:
- There's 6 playable ships, each with two different versions that play almost entirely different (effectively making it 12 ships).
- 5 stages, with completely different alternate versions of stages 2,3, and 4, 2 final bosses, and a true end final boss.
- The game description wasn't lying when it said there's a mix of 40 bosses and mid-bosses. And they're mostly really good.
- Dynamic difficulty system that works surprisingly well.
- Good stage training modes and boss rush modes for practicing.

And it's not just all stats either, it's got the good game design to go along with it: 
Some ships function very differently from others and will force you to heavily adapt how you play the game. Bosses are menacing and will not shy away from getting right up in your face, forcing you to leave the comfort zone at the bottom of the screen. Bosses sometimes come in groups and often times have strategic dismemberment. 
The dynamic difficulty system affects game speed, enemy attack difficulty, and your own attack power, and will adapt to provide an easier experience if you're struggling, and a tougher experience if you manage to keep up.
The music isn't mind-blowing but it complements the action nicely and some tracks will stick with you.

All in all, pretty great. It's not nearly stellar or stylish enough to threaten Hellsinker's throne, but it's the closest I've seen a shmup get in a long time and you won't want to miss it.

An absolute tour de force. A shmup full of imaginative patterns, chaos, and rapid-fire fun. Magnificently paced, endlessly charming. Mecha Ritz really does earn its spot proudly right next to Crimzon Clover, Eschatos, and Mushihimesama. It is that good.

The rank system slides perfectly up and down, making the game faster and more chaotic, but you stronger, the better you do, and easier the more you take it on the chin. This creates a wonderful risk vs reward metric by making the game more and more intense the better you play. Combine with all the extra lives it gives you (A ridiculous amount compared to others in the genre. I would get 3-5 shields and 3-5 bombs usually each level.), and the game manages to make room for terrible play as well as reward extremely good play with crazier patterns.

Of course, you have to manage a decent rank to get the best ending, but even the bad ending is a rip roaring good time.

But even without the rank system, you have a game that is just brilliantly put together in every way. Do not let this one pass you by if you like shmups at all.

EDIT: The manual is a readme.txt file in the game install directory and explains the various systems. This is old school as can be.

I love shmups almost as much as I suck at them.

Most other shmups (bullet hells especially) straight-up keep you from going to later levels if you play on easy or use continues. In Mecha Ritz, I didn't get punished for being awful with no ending, I got to fight a really cool boss and won while I was one hit away from death. This game makes it easy for me to enjoy the bullet hell experience while still feeling like I'm actually good at the game.

Oh, yeah: the FM synth music is amazing.

The only real problem I had with the game is that there's no explanation whatsoever as to how things work. How do you gain Rank? What is Heat? Why do bosses shoot a million bullets that then disappear? A game manual or tutorial would fix this right up.

Eventually I'll get the hang of the scoring/ranking system and I won't be as terrible. I can only imagine how much more fun the game will be then.
